content.comment_body: Hello, I'm new here. I've installed the [product_name] demo and can't manage to set up a simple hour counter to turn off a motor after each minute until it's reset. M1 and Q5 are supposed to switch off after 1 minute and then M2 should switch on. M2 is switching on, but M1 and Q5 stay on. Why does the C003 contact open and turn off the motor? I'd appreciate any help. Thanks, [user_name]
Hello, Please upload your .lsc file (you'll need to zip it first). M1 and Q5 are currently kept active by your 'positive rail' on the left side.
Here's one potential solution: Once the 1 minute period passes, the operating hour counter activates and removes the hold on Q5. This also resets the maintenance interval.

Is there a bug in the demo, or is this just a limit of the demo version? Something strange is happening. I completely remade the program just as before, and now the opposite is happening. The motor turns off, but the light won't come on. It looks like C001 can't control two contacts. Why is this? I added another timer but it still doesn't work.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are encountering difficulties creating basic automation logic with the [product_name] demo, such as implementing an hour counter for output control. The software shows inconsistent behavior—sometimes outputs fail to switch off properly, while other times relays operate incorrectly. Users are uncertain whether these issues are due to limitations or bugs in the demo software, and are confused about the logic involving contacts and timers.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the [product_name] demo to support creation and simulation of common timing and control logics, like hour counters and switching outputs. They also want clarity regarding demo version restrictions that may affect this functionality.
